notes.title: Soulbound Legacy Supporter Pack Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re excited to launch the Soulbound Legacy Supporter Pack, a special DLC created to support the original developers of Soulbound and give fans a deeper look into how it all came together. Available right now 20% off launch discount!

This pack is packed with behind-the-scenes content, including:

🎙️ A full development interview with Schmooving Studios

📓 Tons of exclusive insights, artwork, and dev notes

💾 Digital goodies that celebrate the long journey from prototype to release

If you've enjoyed Soulbound and want to support the team that started it all, this is the best way to do it. 

All proceeds go directly to the original team, making this an awesome way to support them and celebrate the game’s Legacy.

Thanks for being part of the community. We couldn’t have done this without you! 

– The Dink Team

notes.title: Soulbound Legacy Launch - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you once again for your incredible support!
Finally, Introducing the Soulbound Legacy update. A final push from the original development team to update and polish Soulbound to the original vision!

It brings with it tons of new features, including achievements, updated visuals and Steam Remote Play, so you can finally cross souls with your friends online!

We’ll also be putting out some smaller bug fixes and tweaks in the near future, but this update squashes most of the known bugs from the original build.

🌟 Key Features Added⏱️ New Visuals 
We’ve refreshed the look of the game, updating some background visuals, character sprites and some animations, all with enhanced UI and effects, not to worry though, the classic visuals can still be found in survival mode for those of you who don't use dark mode!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/f54197298859ebb91dba1aca558158fab2b765f4.png"]🧾 Compendium
Browse through detailed lore, stats, and backstories for all Soulbound characters. Along with this is included key information regarding enemy type, health points as well as a difficulty rating on how hard they are to play. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/0e2aa6a1f93fa81dbadbeed62cadbc4961e53283.png"]
🎮 Remote Play Support
You can now play Soulbound Legacy with friends via Steam Remote Play.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/54af6ed98a955825730f07ba3f0d27a85d3329d3.png"]
🏆 Achievements
We’ve implemented 12 brand new Steam achievements to the game for you to show off your mastery!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/82e0e6b129189c3f95cb19168602bcce8c285357.png"]
🎯 Character Practice Ranges
Each character now has their own practice range to hone your skills before a match.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/647bc2615f431915552e49548b12a512eb2876e0.png"]
🎮 Full Controller Support / Steam Deck Verified 
From menus to gameplay, controller support is now seamless on both PC and Steam Deck.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/0788db1b47bb313b4ca26b4163b314dd846da4c2.png"] 
❤️ Soulbound Legacy: Supporter Pack
Alongside this update we’re also announcing the Soulbound Legacy: Supporter Pack.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42855179/5f1619c09b0db0b03337121a79cbea7a663d7457.jpg"]

The Supporter Pack will directly support the original Soulbound developers and includes tons of behind the scenes information about the development of Soulbound, and other cool digital goodies which shows everything it took to get here, including a development interview with Schmooving Studios!


➕ Additional Features / Changes
Score now displays in Survival mode

Added support for Linux

Added support for MacOS

Game icons and visuals updated to reflect the new Soulbound Legacy branding

Game mode descriptions added

New Icon appears when you die/fail in Time Attack

User interface icons added for controller users

Added Discord Rich Presence

Added a brief how-to-play section for new players

Added in-game control scheme for PC & Controllers 

Localised the game's store page 

Added new indicator on the main menu 
🐞 Bugs Squashed
Win Screen now lets you return to the menu or restart

Controller pause menu is now fully navigable

Compendium properly displays from main menu

Fixed tile duplication causing extra enemies

Fixed missing mouse cursor when using keyboard with a controller plugged in

Replaced old "How to Play" screen with clearer visuals

Fixed players unable to navigate back from selected menus

Main menu highlight colour now consistently red

Fixed enemy spawn issue in new tilesets

Fixed player not moving on game start

Fixed bug where a player in VS mode could possess two enemies simultaneously

Fixed enemies not giving the player score in survival mode
⚠️ Known Issues
We’re aware of a few lingering bugs and are already working on a small patch to address them shortly. In the meantime, if you run into any additional issues, please let us know!

💬 We’ve opened a Discussion Page in the Steam Community where our dev team will be actively reading and responding to feedback. 

Thanks for helping us make Soulbound Legacy even better!  And that’s everything! Soulbound wouldn’t be the same without this update and this update wouldn’t have happened without you, so from Schmooving Studios and the rest of the Soulbound team, thank you!!!  

Thanks again for all your support!

-The Dink Team

notes.title: We Heard You!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
When we first shared that we’d be sunsetting Soulbound on June 30th, 2025, it was a tough call. After Dink acquired the original Soulbound development team and the game’s IP, we planned to wrap up the final patch and shift focus to new creative projects with the incredibly talented folks we’d brought onboard.

That was the plan, until something unexpected happened.

You showed up. Loudly.  Over the past few weeks, more than 100,000 players added Soulbound to their Steam libraries, and we received an outpouring of messages, reviews, and support asking us to reconsider, and so, we did.

We’re thrilled to share that:
Soulbound will remain available on Steam, free to all, permanently.

Because of your passion, we’re putting in the extra time, care, and resources to keep Soulbound alive. Here’s what that means:

The game stays up, permanently, and will always be free

We’ll continue future support with a few quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and even new features

And yes, the originally planned "Sunsetting" update on June 30th is still coming. 
(although I think we will have to rethink that name)

Soulbound has always been a passion project, scrappy, strange, full of heart, and now it has a second life thanks to you.

The team behind Soulbound is now part of Dink, and we’ve got bold new projects on the horizon, bigger in scope but carrying the same creative spirit.  

It’s rare that a quiet game gets a second chance.

If you're only just finding out now, welcome aboard. You’re not too late.

It’s staying right where it belongs.

Thank you for letting us hear you, and thank you for giving Soulbound a future.

See you soon,

– The Dink Team
